_note: Visa PREPARATION checklist: general items that official and travel sources commonly list for short-term visas to Japan from India. Not immigration advice, never a prediction of an outcome. Every item must be confirmed with the official sources below. Owner to review and set lastReviewed.

links.label: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan: Visa
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan: JAPAN eVISA

items.text: Check whether JAPAN eVISA covers your trip (it is for single-entry tourism)
Check where to apply: purposes other than tourism are applied for through the Embassy, a Consulate or an accredited agency
Passport valid for your whole stay, with blank pages
Visa application form, completed and signed
Recent passport-size photo (check the current size rules)
Proof you can pay for the trip, such as recent bank statements
Income proof, such as income tax returns
Proof that you are a student, such as a student ID or a letter from your institution
If someone else is paying, their financial documents and your relationship to them
Documents about the business visit, such as a letter from the company in Japan and from your own company
Documents from the person you are visiting in Japan, such as an invitation letter and proof of your relationship
